items.name: Freezing Sling Bullets
items.text:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
This chilly ammunition is dark blue and cold to the touch. When activated freezing ammunition hits a target, the target must succeed at a DC 19 Fortitude save save or be Slowed 1 for 1 round by the intense cold (slowed 1 for 1 minute on a critical failure).

items.name: Deep Cover Specialist
items.text: For matters relating to spycraft and undercover operations, Urdun Gravelhands is a 14th-level challenge.

items.name: Favored City
items.text: Urdun can establish a settlement of at least 5,000 people as his favored city by spending 1 week exploring and making contacts there. He can use his Favored City Lore skill to Recall Knowledge about the city; he gains a +4 circumstance bonus to his Deception and Stealth checks while in his favored city; and he applies abilities like city shepherd to his allies while in his favored city. Urdun can have only one favored city at a time (Corentyn, at the beginning of this adventure), replacing his prior settlement whenever he establishes a new favored city.

items.name: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Poison
City Shepherd
items.text: While in his favored city, all allies who can observe Urdun can add their level + 2 as their proficiency bonus when attempting Deception or Stealth checks, as if Following the Expert.

items.name: Fighting Drink
items.text:
Trigger Urdun rolls Initiative

---
Effect He consumes a dose of alcohol and begins his Soused Ruse as a free action. He rolls Deception for Initiative. Creatures that haven't acted yet are Off-Guard to him.

items.name: Soused Ruse
items.text:
Trigger Urdun consumes a dose of alcohol

---
Effect He appears to become drunk (the same as succumbing to stage 1 of alcohol's poison) without suffering from the condition, and he gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to feint against creatures that assume he's intoxicated. A creature can identify his ruse either by Sensing Motive or by succeeding at a Medicine check against his Deception DC while observing him within 30 feet.

Effect: Soused Ruse

items.name: Break Bottle
items.text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect Urdun shatters a bottle and uses it to brawl. For the next 1 minute when he makes a fist Strike, he can choose for the Strike to lose the unarmed trait, gain the versatile P trait, and deal 1d6 persistent bleed damage on critical hits.

items.name: Ruse Drinker
items.text: Urdun Draws and Activates a consumable item he can drink, such as a potion, elixir, or alcoholic drink.

items.name: Sneak Attack
items.text: Urdun's Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage against Off-Guard creatures.

items.name: Sobering Stride
items.text:
Requirements Urdun's Soused Ruse is active

---
Effect Urdun pretends to sober up as he moves more quickly. He Strides twice and ends his Soused Ruse.

items.name: Soused Blow
items.text:
Requirements Urdun's Soused Ruse is active

---
Effect Urdun pretends to stumble while preparing a punch. He Feints then makes a melee Strike.
